summary: Zepp Health Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The release covers operational and financial highlights, including revenue of US$63.5 million, gross margin of 37.4%, and a net loss of US$11.3 million. Management comments discuss product launches and portfolio performance across various families. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No transactions, strategic reviews, or corporate events are described. The registrant acts solely as the issuer reporting ordinary financial information.
